figurative_meaning_en: Expression of unwillingness, dissatisfaction, or non-cooperation
example_sentences_in_bangla: কাজটা করতে বললাম তো মুখ ঘুরিয়ে চলে গেল।
প্রস্তাব শুনে সে মুখ ঘুরিয়ে উঠল।
example_sentences_in_english: When I asked him to do the work, he turned his face away and left.
Upon hearing the proposal, she turned her face away in disapproval.
note: This idiom reflects non-verbal cues common in Bengali interpersonal dynamics.
